deck: These sitting members appear in public records involving Anthropic’s network, from campaign gifts and outside spending for or against candidates to bill mentions and public statements.
note: The records leave the effect on votes open.
bridge: First, gifts from Anthropic’s employees and PAC.

head: Anthropic employee and PAC gifts reached 10 of today’s members by the end of 2024 and 200 by Sept. 2026.
deck: Anthropic employees gave $6.0M of their own money, 92% of it in 2026. Anthropic’s political action committee (PAC) gave $232K.
note: Employer is as the giver reported it to the FEC, including misspellings and entries in the occupation box. The amounts are gross contributions before refunds. The record runs through Sept. 30, 2026.
bridge: Anthropic separately announced funding for a political nonprofit. How much?
source: FEC contributions to campaigns, leadership PACs and single-member joint fundraising committees linked to serving members.

head: Anthropic announced $40.0M for Public First Action.
deck: Commonwealth Together PAC reported spending against Seth Moulton’s Senate bid months before its receipt from the nonprofit.
note: The filings show where money went and when. They give no reason for the spending or trace gifts to expenses. The receipt came too late to pay for the earlier spending.
